name: DMD 5560
title: Advanced Digital Game Design and Development
description: Practical examination into the development of three-dimensional video games. Students are required to design and develop a video game and extensive game design document. Participants explore a selection of advanced game engines, share and critique ideas, investigate the business aspect of the video game industry, and deliver a series of progress reports as part of the development of a video game project.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
